title: Informational Writing for Kids — Episode 1: What Is It?
skills: define informational writing and explain its purpose
distinguish informational writing from narrative and opinion writing
identify common features of clear nonfiction writing
organize factual information to explain a topic effectively
alignment_note: Provides an accessible introduction to informational writing and its purpose of explaining facts, ideas, and topics clearly. Although designed for younger learners, it can serve as foundational review, intervention, or multilingual reinforcement for expository writing, nonfiction structure, and audience-focused communication across high school English courses.
